ratings.note: Any ingest run with unmatched themes reaches an undocumented step that the schema blocks, and the only way through mislabels user feedback as an independent inspector, which silently inflates the k-of-N agreement the person relies on.

The step shape is natural enough to recur across evals and subagent roles, and the opaque error costs retries and guesswork, but agents recover by rewriting to the documented form, so it is a minor error-message problem.
